profile.headline: HCM Systems Architect | HCM Integrations | Enterprise HRIS & Payroll Platforms | Full-Stack Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m an Enterprise HCM Systems Architect and Computer Science Engineer with 15+ years of experience designing, integrating, and modernizing HR technology platforms across multinational organizations in the US and Latin America.

My expertise sits at the intersection of:

• HRIS architecture
• Payroll and ERP integrations
• Enterprise data governance
• Full-stack platform development
• Knowledge management systems

I’ve led the technical design and deployment of secure, scalable HR platforms supporting payroll, personnel administration, and enterprise HR operations. I specialize in building systems that align technical architecture with compliance, data security, and operational scalability.

My long-term focus is building next-generation HCM platforms where technical architecture, domain expertise, and product thinking converge, particularly within high-growth HR tech startups.

projects.title: HR Chatbot
projects.description:
R&D: using python language and the Natural Language Processing Toolkit we are building a virtual assistant that can answer, to your employees or anyone within your organization, information about all your HR & organizational data. E.G., how much PTO do I have? What are my benefits? Do I have access to medical insurance? What is my schedule for next week? Is the office open on Monday?

Also, it will answer analytical information. E.g., How percentage of employees are men? How many employees are in a particular store location? What is the rotation percentage this month?

This chatbot will learn all about your organization so your employees can have access to their information without complications.

For more information, please send us an email to hello@dksystems.tech.

projects.title: Ibeacons envato - IoT Location Detection
projects.description:
E beacons son parte del mundo de IoT que tienen un mundo de aplicaciones en todas las industrias y tipo de organizaciones. Estos dispositivos tienen la capcidad de detectar de manera inalámbrica utilizando los servicios de bluetooth para detectar la posición de las personas. En este proyecto estamos aprovechando los beneficios de estos dispositivos para transformar el proceso de salida de los alumnos de una escuela de manera digital.

Se desarrolló una plataforma móvil, en donde los padres con su celular pueden avisar a los maestros en qué orden de la fila están. Además, los maestros tienen un reporte en tiempo real, de quién está esperando en fila. Así los alumnos pueden estar listos y el proceso de recoger a los hijos se agiliza.
